overview_description.description: Geek Express is an Edtech platform that teaches students STEAM through a comprehensive Arabized journey of online coding classes, DIY STEM kits and self-paced STEAM video lessons. As a startup, we set the model for a futuristic school where students can learn independently of age, location, and medium of learning. We are an online learning platform enabling K-12 students with accredited technology skills through a frictionless journey that guarantees convenience for parents and engagement for students. Students enjoy a gamified journey where they get to develop their own apps, AI programs, and 3D games, guided by Microsoft-certified trainers. They also earn certificates approved by KHDA Dubai, and STEM USA. Our platform sets the model of a futuristic global school of 21st century skills.
